_meta.source: Screens extracted losslessly from talon_ats.pdf (img2pdf container, embedded PNGs at 2880x1800). The design is 1440x900 CSS at 2x.

confidence.color: HIGH — every value under color.primitive marked (measured) was sampled pixel-wise from the 2x originals. Unmarked ramp steps are interpolated between measured anchors.
confidence.layout: HIGH — measured by scanning for border transitions on the 2x originals and halving. Values are exact to +/-1 CSS px.
confidence.typography: MEDIUM — pinned 2026-08-08 (spec 003 step 6) against 03-pipeline-kanban, 02-jobs-list and 01-sign-in. Method: compare RENDERED TEXT-RUN WIDTHS of long strings, not glyph heights — the endpoints of a long run are strong stems that survive anti-aliasing, while cap heights do not. FINDING: the two families were wrong in different directions, so there is no single scale factor. The BODY family (Inter) was ~25% too large across every token and was multiplied by 0.80: six independent runs gave 0.755-0.817, and code independently implied 10.4px against its new 10px. The DISPLAY family (Inter Tight) was already correct and is UNCHANGED — pageTitle measured 0.99 on 'Welcome back' (12 chars) and sectionTitle 1.03 on 'Senior Product Engineer' (23 chars). This CORRECTS spec 001 §2.1, which recorded pageTitle at 0.73 and cardTitle at 0.80 from cap-height ink extents; the cardTitle figure was right, the pageTitle figure was a cap-height artifact and a 4-character sample ('Jobs') reproduces it misleadingly. STILL UNVERIFIED: metricXl (Reports is not built, no sample exists) and eyebrow (no clean run isolated; it keeps its step below caption). RESIDUAL: hero measures 0.913 on one run and vertical metrics run ~0.87 against widths of ~0.79 — both point at the FONT FAMILY rather than the sizes, since the reference face is narrower than Inter. Pin the family before calling this HIGH.
confidence.shadow: LOW — estimated. The reference separates surfaces with borders, so there is little shadow to sample.
confidence.motion: NONE — static screenshots carry no timing information. These are conventions, not observations.

_meta.correctionNote: An earlier draft of this file was measured from a 1389px-wide render and was ~3.7% small throughout. All layout values below are re-measured at true scale. Type sizes WERE rescaled on 2026-08-08 by 0.80 - see confidence.typography.

measured - Screen stage, Closing pill, careers-page source

teal.$description: NOT measured - no teal appears in the reference; included only to complete the avatar palette

selected.$description: active sidebar item, selected review-queue row

status._note: Job status pills. bg + text pairs, all ≥4.5:1.

stage._note: One hue per canonical pipeline stage. Used for the column dot, the column progress rule, the stage chips on the candidate header, and the funnel bars on Reports. Never the only carrier of meaning — always paired with the stage label.

source._note: Hires-by-source legend on Reports; reuse for source tags on pipeline cards.

chart._note: Interviews-per-week trend on Reports. barIdle is measured off 08-reports@2x.png (solid fill, single mode over 2176 samples) and is deliberately NOT indigo.200 (#C2C6F1) — the ramp between the measured 50 and 600 anchors is interpolated, so it misses this value. barCurrent sampled as exactly #4C56C8 and so references the primitive rather than restating it, which is the evidence the PNG carries no colour shift. Never the only carrier of meaning — every bar is labelled with its value.

busyFill.$description: rendered with a 45° hatch pattern, not flat — pattern is the a11y carrier

avatar._note: Assigned by stable hash of user/candidate id. First five are measured from reference avatars. All are AA against white text at 12px bold.

typography._note: The reference display face is a warm geometric grotesk with a tall x-height and a single-storey feel in the headline ('Hiring, coordinated.') — closest commercial matches are Söhne or Basis Grotesque. Shipping recommendation below uses open, self-hostable faces so no licence blocks the build. If a licence is available, swap 'Inter Tight' for the real display face; nothing else in the scale changes.

sectionTitle.$description: 'Senior Product Engineer' detail header, candidate name

cardTitle.$description: job row title, candidate card name

numeric.$description: apply to every count, duration, currency, and metric so columns don't jitter on update

space._note: 4px base. Card interior padding is 16; gap between cards 10; page gutter 24.

shadow._note: Deliberately restrained — the reference separates surfaces with borders and background contrast, not elevation. Shadows appear only on drag, popovers, and modals.

dragging.$description: kanban card while held, paired with 2deg tilt
